content:
The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in panel-level margins and aggregate totals compared to expected values.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed with 'close(369.2, 6276.4)' returning False, indicating a major calculation error in panel margins. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because 'total_annual_margin_14_day_usd' was 26185.96 instead of the expected 1090.76. While the script successfully loaded and processed 3 out of 5 tests, the core financial logic produced incorrect outputs.
